oracleAmendmentLedger.authorityBoundary: All seven are Lumen-authored oracle amendments derived from physical-corpus closure and schema truth. None was learned from current search output, ranking, or seeder behavior; none is a neutral seed repair.

cases.reason: Case-local physical-FK namespace replaces a broad prefix after the required Person parent became a searchable corpus source; the parent is explicitly adjudicated.
Deliberate semantic oracle redesign from an operation-type prefix to a case-local related-ID prefix; this was not required by a physical-domain rejection.
Case-local related-person namespace replaces a broad completed-corpus prefix and removes accidental operation-enum overlap.
Case-local physical-FK namespace replaces a broad Mission prefix after the required Mission parent became a searchable corpus source; the parent is explicitly adjudicated.
Case-local physical-FK namespace makes the newly materialized searchable Line parent an explicit adjudicated hit; no claim of a prior broad-prefix collision is made.
Deliberate semantic redesign because 17 required Journey creator Approvals truthfully use InitiateJourney; the case now tests a case-local related-ID substring.
Deliberate semantic redesign from a non-unique category enum to a case-local description substring. claim.description remains transitional through H4 and narrow-by-default for H5.
